description: This file defines a class MyGLRenderer which implements GLSurfaceView.Renderer for rendering OpenGL ES graphics. It contains methods for rendering frames, handling surface changes, compiling shaders, and managing transformation matrices. It also references external classes such as Triangle and Square for drawable objects.

classes.name: MyGLRenderer
classes.description: Renderer class for OpenGL ES that manages drawing frames, setting up matrices, and shader compilation. It also handles user interactions for rotating objects.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL environment and drawable objects.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Per-frame rendering method, clears buffers, sets camera, applies transformations, and draws objects.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix based on surface dimensions.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles an OpenGL shader of given type with provided shader code.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors after a GL operation.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Returns the current rotation angle of the objects.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle for animation purposes.
